name: patent_claims
description: Independent and dependent claims from a patent document.
instructions: Extract every claim stated in the document as a separate record. Preserve the claim's own wording; do not paraphrase or summarise. A dependent claim records the claim number it depends on. Do not infer claim scope that is not written.

fields.name: claim_number
fields.description: The claim number as printed, e.g. 1.

fields.name: claim_type
fields.description: Whether the claim stands alone or refers to another claim.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.description: For a dependent claim, the claim number it refers to, else null.

fields.name: key_limitation
fields.description: The limitation that distinguishes this claim, in the source's words.

fields.name: source_span
fields.description: REQUIRED verbatim quote (<=200 chars) supporting this record.
